tasks_completed.description: Fixed dragOptionId computation to use edAcc.options[0].option_id fallback for v1 flat accommodation objects
tasks_completed.changes: Replaced `acc.option_id || selectedAccId` (always null for v1 flat objects) with a 5-level fallback chain: selectedAccId || acc.selected_option_id || acc.options[0].option_id || edAcc.options[0].option_id || null. Added editorHasExplicitNull guard to prevent false positives on explicitly-deselected slots.
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: acc = day.accommodation is a v1 flat object with no option_id/options[]. acc.option_id = undefined. selectedAccId = null (editorDay.accommodation.selected_option_id is null, nothing in editorSelections). All fallbacks in cycle 1 fix also null because acc.options is absent. The actual option IDs live in editorDay.accommodation.options[] (loaded from /api/trip which returns v2 day data). edAcc is already computed in scope; edAcc.options[0].option_id = 'accommodation-1-1'.

tasks_completed.description: Fixed data-option-id attribute to use dragOptionId instead of acc.option_id
tasks_completed.changes: Changed `data-option-id={acc.option_id || undefined}` to `data-option-id={dragOptionId || undefined}` so the DOM attribute reflects the resolved option ID.
tasks_completed.rationale: Consistency: the draggable attribute and onDragStart payload already used dragOptionId; data-option-id must match.

tasks_completed.description: Regenerated HTML and deployed both trips, busted serve-trip.py in-memory cache
tasks_completed.changes: Re-ran generate-html-interactive.py for both trips, deployed via deploy-travel-plans.sh, invalidated serve-trip.py in-memory HTML cache via POST /api/save with empty mutations.
tasks_completed.rationale: serve-trip.py caches generated HTML in memory; cache invalidation required for the live /trip/ endpoint to serve updated code.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A — data structure mismatch (v1 flat accommodation.json vs v2 days/day-NN.json slot format)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: dragOptionId was computed as `acc.option_id || selectedAccId`. For trips using v1 flat accommodation.json data, acc.option_id is always undefined. selectedAccId is null when editorDay.accommodation.selected_option_id is null and editorSelections has no entry. The actual option IDs are only in editorDay.accommodation.options[] (from /api/trip v2 response), which was never consulted.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Added edAcc.options[0].option_id as the last fallback before null. edAcc = editorDay.accommodation is already computed in scope and contains the v2 slot data with options[]. This makes the board card draggable as soon as editorTripData loads (async, ~100ms after page render).

dev.qa_notes: 1. Verify card 0 (board primary accommodation card for Day 1) has draggable='true' and data-option-id='accommodation-1-1' after page load + 3s wait. 2. Verify drag from board to candidates sidebar triggers POST /api/save with mutations=[{type:'select',slot:'accommodation',option_id:null}]. 3. Verify board accommodation count drops to 0 after drag. 4. Verify all 9 days have draggable accommodation cards. 5. Note: serve-trip.py in-memory cache requires a POST /api/save (or server restart) to invalidate after template changes — the static deploy files are NOT used by /trip/ endpoint.

self_verification.notes: Playwright verification confirmed: before fix draggable='false' data-option-id=null; after fix draggable='true' data-option-id='accommodation-1-1'. /api/save intercepted with mutations=[{type:'select',slot:'accommodation',option_id:null}]. Board accommodation DOM count after drag: 0.

recommendations: serve-trip.py should expose a /api/admin/cache-invalidate endpoint (or auto-invalidate on template mtime change) to avoid stale HTML after template edits without a save event.
Consider adding selected_option_id to the v1 flat accommodation objects during data migration so the simpler fallbacks suffice without reaching into editorDay.
